description: Start a saved workflow on a timetable. Needs an administrator key. Each start is a run billed to the organization, with the cost cap given here (or the default). Use preview_schedule first to check the timetable. A schedule pauses itself after repeated failed starts. An organization can have 50 schedules.

cron.description: Five fields (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), such as "0 9 * * 1-5", or a descriptor such as @daily or @every 15m. At most once a minute.

enabled.description: Whether the schedule starts runs (default true).

input.description: Any JSON the agent receives as its input on every start (maximum 1 MiB).

max_cost_micros.description: Cost cap of each run, in millionths of a dollar.

skip_if_running.description: Skip a start while the previous run is still going (default true).

timezone.description: IANA time zone name, such as Europe/Madrid (default UTC).

workflow.description: Name of the saved workflow to run (see list_workflows).

name: create_schedule
title: Create a schedule
